head: 3273431fcfc9f50abf85d7ed41bc562bb57294fc
summary:
Build attempt 3 (2e4eb27 to 3273431) changes one src file, three test files and the as-built doc. Commit 2e4eb27 itself changed only .taad bookkeeping. I read the whole diff and the files around it. The solution builds with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and 86 of 86 tests pass with none skipped; %TEMP%\fsa-tests is empty afterwards.

O-014: I re-ran the exact mutation that passed silently last time, deleting `!cloudOnly &&` from SizeProbe.IsDue. It now fails AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof (Expected 2, Actual 3). The new fixture offline-large.bin is a 64 MiB all-hole sparse file with OFFLINE. Being sparse keeps it out of the WOF check, so only the large-file branch could probe it. A listing precondition also proves it is at least 64 MiB and OFFLINE. The file was restored from HEAD and matches.

O-015: MainWindow.xaml.cs:142 now reads `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`. The only throws with ParamName "root" in src are the two root rejections in LongPath.NormalizeRoot (lines 24 and 40). Every other ArgumentException now reaches Scan failed: the store's out-of-range "index" and StoreName's "name", plus Path.GetFullPath's "path", which the decision accepts. RootTests and ScanStoreTests pin that ParamName contract. The code comment and the doc paragraph (docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md:41-45) were updated to match. The Scanner and LongPath exception docs are still accurate. I found no other statement left describing the old catch-all behaviour.

The window's filter itself has no automated test, because the App has no test project, and the builder declared that the UI Automation smoke test was refused. I verified the filter by reading it together with the ParamName tests. I found nothing new worth filing.

obligations.evidence: Not touched by attempt 3. src/FsAnalyser.Core/Store/ScanStore.cs keeps fixed column and name pages and the open-addressing FileIdIndex. ScanStoreBudgetTests.FiveMillionEntriesFitTheMemoryBudget passed in this run.

Not touched. ScanStore.ChargedSize/ChargedOnDisk (ScanStore.cs:81-92, Charges :210-211). Scans.Run asserts after every scan that the charged sums equal Totals, and that held for the new offline-large.bin fixture too.
Not touched. LongPathTests.ReachesPathsWin32WouldAlter probes wof. and a./b. under a path over 400 characters. ArchitectureRulesTests.InteropLivesOnlyInNative passed.
SizeProbe.cs:23-30 has LargeFileThreshold and IsDue, unchanged. The documentary and growing-file tests in OnDiskSizeTests.cs:51-93 are unchanged and pass.
Not touched. EntryClassifier.cs:26-27 treats DFS 0x8000000A as a Link, and EntryClassifierTests has the DFS row, which passes.
Not touched. ArchitectureRulesTests.OnlyTheClassifierReadsTheReparseAttribute covers src/** and passes. The new MainWindow lines contain no 0x400 or reparse identifiers.
Not touched. ArchitectureRulesTests.CountingRuleTestsAreNeverSkipped passes, and none of the modified test files adds a Skip or Explicit.

src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs:148-166: every exception other than the root rejection is shown as the 'Scan failed' ending, and the finally block at :153-162 re-enables the pickers. Attempt 3 made this more precise (see O-015).
Not touched. CommandLine.RootArgument, called from App.xaml.cs:11. CommandLineTests' 6 rows pass.
Not touched. TempTree.CreateSymlink (TempTree.cs:139-152) turns 1314 into a Developer Mode message, with no fallback.
Not touched. eng/dotnet.ps1 pins -Version 10.0.401 and checks the Authenticode signature. The build and tests in this review ran through it.
docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md still carries the amendments, and lines 41-45 are updated for O-015.
Not touched. MainWindow.xaml.cs VolumeInUse and Coverage show the drive-root gap in Finished and Stopped. The doc records deferring the explanation.

tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/OnDiskSizeTests.cs:111-114 adds offline-large.bin (64 MiB sparse plus Offline). :128-130 is the listing precondition (EndOfFile >= LargeFileThreshold and OFFLINE set). :153-156 assert Flags == CloudOnly, Size 64 MiB and OnDisk 0, and :136 keeps Probes == 2. My own mutation run, with `!cloudOnly &&` removed from IsDue, failed this test with Expected 2, Actual 3. The file was restored and matches HEAD.

src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs:142 narrows the catch to `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`. The only nameof(root) throws in src are LongPath.cs:24 and :40. tests/.../RootTests.cs:59-60 asserts ParamName "root" through Scanner.Scan, and ScanStoreTests.cs:57-59 asserts the store's out-of-range exception is not "root". Both pass. The docs paragraph at SL-020-scanner.md:41-45 matches. The window path has no automated test (there is no App test project), and the UI check was declared as not run.

cases.evidence: Unchanged. TraversalTests.ReadsEverythingUnderAFolder builds a\b\c (each folder's only child is a subfolder), an empty folder, a 0-byte file and hidden+system entries. It passed.
Unchanged. TraversalTests.ListsAFolderThatSpansSeveralBuffers uses 2,000 names of 100 characters, more than 8 buffers of 64 KiB, and checks each name appears exactly once.
Unchanged. ScanStoreTests.AppendsPastOnePageAndRollsNamesOntoASecondPage appends PageSize+5,000 entries, including the entry that would straddle a name page.

Unchanged. LongPathTests.ReachesPathsWin32WouldAlter covers a path over 400 characters with a 255-character component, dot., 'space ', NUL, a WOF file and a hardlink pair under the deep path, and the UNC string mapping.
Unchanged. LinkTests covers junctions, directory symlinks and file symlinks pointing outside, inside and at an ancestor, plus a dangling link.
Unchanged. HardlinkTests theory rows (2,1), (3,2) and (2,0): the stale name first, three names, and the reverse order.
Unchanged. OnDiskSizeTests.SparseCompressedAndPlainFilesTakeTheListingsOnDiskSize: 64 MiB sparse with 4 KiB written, a 4 MiB LZNT file, and a 10,000-byte plain file.

OnDiskSizeTests.AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof: WOF xpress4k, a 16 MiB all-hole sparse file, a 1 MiB WOF file with OFFLINE, and now a 64 MiB sparse file with OFFLINE for the large-file branch. Also a resident 200-byte file and a denied WOF file. Each has a listing precondition, and a mutation of either cloud guard now fails the test.
Unchanged. UnreadableFolderTests puts a deny-ListDirectory ACE on b-denied between two readable siblings.
RootTests covers a regular file (267), a missing path (2), bare C:, relative and empty roots (now also asserting ParamName "root"), and a junction as the root.
Unchanged. CancellationTests covers cancelling after the third folder of ten and a token cancelled before the call.
Unchanged. ListingFallbackTests forces FILE_FULL_DIR_INFO over a real tree with a hardlink and links.
Unchanged. HardlinkTests.ALoneNameUnderTheRootIsChargedAtItsListingSize: one stale name under the root, charged at 1 MiB, with Probes 0.

drift: No new undeclared departure in attempt 3. The one departure it has (the O-015 UI smoke test was not run, so the window's filter is verified only by the build and the Core ParamName tests) was declared.

Still standing from the previous review: LongPath.NormalizeRoot (src/FsAnalyser.Core/Native/LongPath.cs:27-34) takes a root already in \\?\ or \\?\UNC\ form as-is, without GetFullPath. Neither the original design nor docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md mentions this, though LongPathTests.NormalisesTheRootOnce tests it.

Still standing, and deferred by the person as m3: .taad/fitness.yaml does not exist, so the Fitness gate reports that no architecture rules are declared. The five rules are enforced only by tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/ArchitectureRulesTests.cs.
Still standing, and declared: the engine's stored design record keeps the pre-amendment text, and docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md supersedes it in the repo.
